storiesArchive.title: Leading the Way
storiesArchive.detail: Kirsty Kochanski & Christopher Kochanski nose in front of Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac by 1, nerves well and truly in play.

storiesArchive.title: Family Affair
storiesArchive.detail: The Barac household pairing Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac card 70 gross, 59 net, and no family feud yet.

storiesArchive.title: Keeping it in the Family
storiesArchive.detail: Kirsty Kochanski & Christopher Kochanski keep the Kochanski name on the leaderboard and the ribbing in the car.

storiesArchive.title: Countback Territory
storiesArchive.detail: Shane Matthews & Ben Lawrence and Shaun Lowry & Brendan Madigan dead level on 64.25 net, so the countback gets the final word.

storiesArchive.title: Too Close to Call
storiesArchive.detail: Shane Matthews & Ben Lawrence match Shaun Lowry & Brendan Madigan stroke for stroke on +64.2 - someone fetch the rule book.

storiesArchive.title: Pure Strikers
storiesArchive.detail: Melanie Cramp & Michelle Ford carry 3.75 and a straight face all the way to +69.2.

storiesArchive.title: Strokes to Spare
storiesArchive.detail: The generous end of the draw: Jodie Tancredi & Sharon McLoughlin with 17.25 and +68.8 to show for it.

storiesArchive.title: Strokes in the Bank
storiesArchive.detail: Narelle Jones & Kim Robinson lean on 9.25 and come up with 63.75 net after a 73 gross.

storiesArchive.title: In the Mix
storiesArchive.detail: Middle of the road and loving it, Emma McMahon & Monica Harrison sign 82 gross for 70.5 net.

storiesArchive.title: In the Thick of It
storiesArchive.detail: +70.5 for Emma McMahon & Monica Harrison, the kind of round that gets you a quiet beer and a nod.

storiesArchive.title: Best-Ball Buddies
storiesArchive.detail: Shaun Lowry & Brendan Madigan go 69 gross for 64.25 net with one hero and one honest worker.

storiesArchive.title: Better Together
storiesArchive.detail: A bit of give and take and Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac end up with +59.

storiesArchive.title: Bringing Up the Rear
storiesArchive.detail: Barbara Rodham & Robyn Smith post 104 gross for 85.25 net and have already declared it a win.

storiesArchive.detail: the race that stops a nation, the comp that stops the club - Cup Day golf

storiesArchive.title: Wooden Spoon Watch
storiesArchive.detail: Down the bottom but up on laughs, that's Barbara Rodham & Robyn Smith all over.
